{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit .drawio diagrams in the Web Sidebar ,侧边栏编辑流程图 .drawio文件","id":"gh:1369807038","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-drawioedit","slug":"zhang-guo-wen/dsh-drawioedit","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit .drawio diagrams in the Web Sidebar ,侧边栏编辑流程图 .drawio文件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-drawioedit"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A trimmed upstream draw.io editor integrated into the DeepSeek Harness Web Sidebar, with offline `.d"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rawio` editing and automatic saving back to the original file."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"In the plugin list, display names and descriptions follow the Harness language setting in English or"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" Chinese (English is the default fallback); English names use the package name without its npm scope"},{"id":"p5s3","text":", Chinese names describe the purpose, and installation still uses the unchanged real package name."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Restart the host after installation."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What this plugin adds"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Sidebar integration**: connects the upstream editor to the DSH file tree and sidebar tabs to edi"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"t workspace `.drawio` files directly. Chinese file names display correctly, with no separate online "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"editor or diagram upload required. The tab type claims files by address shape (`dsh-resource://file/"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"**/*.drawio`), so a co-installed third-party sidebar that ships its own source editor (better-sideba"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"r, for instance) still opens `.drawio` in the diagram editor by default; inside that workbench the e"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ditor also offers a Diagram / Source switch.
- **Package trimming**: removes server-side Java resour"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ces, uncompressed development sources, specialist stencil packs, and their icons and templates. Rebu"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ilds a trimmed stencil bundle and cleans the template index while retaining everyday drawing tools. "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"The trimmed local package is **12.1 MB compressed / 42.7 MiB unpacked** (`npm pack --dry-run`; the p"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"ublished version may differ).
- **Automatic saving**: bridges the editor to the host's file service,"},{"id":"p10s11","text":" detects diagram changes, and writes them back to the original file without exporting, downloading, "},{"id":"p10s12","text":"and replacing it manually. Saves run sequentially, retaining only the newest pending changes; the pl"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"ugin's own line above the frame shows **Saving…** or **Renaming…** while one of those is in flight, "},{"id":"p10s14","text":"and a landed write is confirmed by the editor's own toolbar instead, so nothing moves the editor as "},{"id":"p10s15","text":"changes land.
- **Permission and conflict protection**: saves respect the session's workspace permis"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"sions and check file versions to avoid silently overwriting changes made by an agent or another prog"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"ram while the editor is open. Permission denials, version conflicts, and other save failures are sho"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"wn in the tab, and a file the plugin could not read offers **Retry** in place.
